measured.method: COD: 120 pack CIFs with the search's downloader (4 workers, 0.2 s delay, retries); sizes from 1291 cached pack CIFs. MP: 600 structures in batches of 200; index = one metadata query. Sticks (2026-11-16): 800 pack structures (400 COD, 400 MP), Cu K-alpha1, 2theta 1-130 deg, 3 worker processes, mean of 2 runs; disk size in 4 KiB clusters. COD over rsync (cod_rsync_per_s, 2026-11-17; 16 files/s is the rate of the app's 300-file steps including the connection, 601 files in 42.4 s end to end; the pack minutes assume rsync): 300 pack CIFs, MSYS2 rsync 3.5.2, same PC and network, HTTP download running at the same time.

packs.name: Recommended: battery and semiconductor elements
packs.description: Every COD and Materials Project structure made only of these elements (any combination).
packs.element_notes: Union of the battery list (Li Na K Mg Al Si P S Ti V Mn Fe Co Ni Cu Zn Zr Nb La C O H F) and the semiconductor list (Si Ge Ga As In P N Al Sb Zn Cd S Se Te Sn Cu O Hf Ti Ta W), plus B (borate coatings, B-doped Si, BN), Cl (chloride solid electrolytes, LiCl/NaCl synthesis residues) and Mo (MoS2/MoO3 electrodes, Mo back contacts).
